title: hp-1: slot table in pkcs11.c + update all C_* slot functions
description: Replace hardcoded slotID==0 checks with a wp11_slot_t g_slots[] table. Slot 0 = soft token (always present). Slots 1..N = USB tokens (dynamically managed by hotplug). Update C_GetSlotList, C_GetSlotInfo, C_GetTokenInfo, C_GetMechanismList, C_GetMechanismInfo, C_OpenSession, C_CloseAllSessions, C_InitToken to use the table.
